name: Kamiki Mikoto
source:
The protagonist's mother who is kind and calm.
She shows kindness and deep love not just to the protagonist and Suzume, but also towards Setsura, Mio, and Chieri.
But she has a jealous side and wont tolerate her husband chatting with the girls, talking about her age is also forbidden.
